name: humanai
description: AI agents + human for hardware setup and verification

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && ELECTRON_DEV=true electron ."
scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist-main/checklists'; if(!fs.existsSync(p))fs.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync('electron/checklists').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('electron/checklists/'+f, p+'/'+f));"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
